summary: António Teixeira de Sousa (1857–1917) was a Regenerator politician and the last President of the Council of Ministers of the Portuguese constitutional monarchy, in office from June 1910 until the Republic was proclaimed on 5 October of that year. He is in the atlas as the holder of that turn at the headship of the government.
